recommendations.body: `plan_tool/review.py:_sibling_roadmap_identity()` (step 1 “Select eligible sibling creates using existing roadmap identity”) assigns plain-frontmatter seeds to `plan_path.parent/roadmaps/<slug>` even when the resolved source structurally identifies another roadmap root. With unavailable lifecycle state, a seed under `a/roadmaps/demo/seeds` incorrectly accepts creates from `b/roadmaps/demo` when both accepted versions contain matching row IDs. This violates same-owner isolation; existing tests cover separate plan directories but not conflicting source ownership.
recommendations.suggested_action: in `plan_tool/review.py:_sibling_roadmap_identity()`, preserve structurally identified source ownership during plain-frontmatter fallback and add conflicting-owner regression coverage in `tests/test_review.py:TestEligibleSiblingCreates`
